name: pulse-media-assets
description: Optimizes media and asset handling for React components in this Laravel Vite app. Use for responsive images, lazy loading, import.meta.glob, asset request counts, alt text, image sizing, viewport loading, video, and below-the-fold media.
purpose: Reduce pageload requests, avoid layout shift, and keep image/video rendering accessible and responsive.
single_responsibility: Media and asset handling for components: eager/lazy loading, responsive images, stable dimensions, alt text, and request count.
triggers: Component renders images, video, icons, or large asset sets
Lazy loading or responsive image behaviour is changing
`import.meta.glob` or Vite asset loading is involved
Request count or first paint is a concern
completion_criteria: Eager vs lazy loading is chosen per viewport position
Image dimensions or aspect ratios are stable to avoid layout shift
`src`, `srcSet`, and `sizes` are deterministic across server and client render
Meaningful images have useful alt text and decorative images have empty alt
Existing responsive image utilities are reused when available
validation_criteria: Build verification is planned for Vite asset changes
failure_handling: If media cannot load without layout shift, excessive requests, or broken hydration, stop and report the constraint instead of shipping it.
Report any asset or build behaviour that could not be verified.
escalation_path: Route uncertain Vite asset, `import.meta.glob`, or responsive image APIs through pulse-docs-research.
Escalate to the user when reducing requests requires removing or replacing assets (a content or scope decision).
Hand broader bundle or render performance to pulse-performance-vercel and alt-text semantics to pulse-accessibility-wcag.
responsibilities: Choose eager vs lazy media loading.
Use responsive image components when available.
Preserve width, height, aspect ratio, and alt text.
Avoid eager imports of large asset sets unless needed for first paint.
Avoid creating responsive `srcSet` or image requests for offscreen gallery items until they are near the viewport.
non_responsibilities: Visual art direction beyond media fit and cropping.
Creating new image assets unless requested.
